disableConfirm.title: Disable {{name}}?
disableConfirm.description: The site will no longer be accessible.

maintenanceConfirm.title: Put {{name}} into maintenance mode?
maintenanceConfirm.description: Visitors will see a "under construction" page instead of the site.

switchConfirm.title: Switch {{name}} to its duplicate?
switchConfirm.description: All traffic will be routed to the backup copy. Use in case of failure or system error. Reversible.

migrationTitleReady: Captures this site (container, volumes, database, Nginx config) to the backup USB drive, for migration to a new server
migrationTitleNotReady: Connect and configure a backup USB drive (Backups screen) to enable migration
migrationStarted: Migration capture started for {{name}} — follow progress in Backups.

failoverErrors.vhost_in_maintenance: This site is in maintenance mode — exit maintenance before switching to the duplicate.
failoverErrors.no_duplicate_found: No duplicate exists for this site.
failoverErrors.duplicate_not_ready: The duplicate isn't ready yet (creation or refresh in progress).
failoverErrors.duplicate_container_unavailable: The duplicate's container couldn't be started — check its status on the Docker screen.
failoverErrors.vhost_not_switched_to_duplicate: This site is not currently switched to its duplicate.
failoverErrors.snapshot_not_found: The site's previous configuration couldn't be found — cannot revert automatically.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.explanation: The duplicate is frozen at the moment it was created — changes made to the original since then aren't reflected automatically. "Update" makes a fresh, complete copy (files + database) from the current original.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete the duplicate?
deleteConfirm.description: The duplicated content, database, and container (if any) will be permanently deleted.

duplicate.none: No duplicate for this site. Create one to be able to switch traffic to it in case of failure.

createDialog.introContent: The site's folder content will be copied.
createDialog.introContainer: A second container (same image, different port) will be created and started.
createDialog.introSelectDb: Select a database below if this site uses one.
createDialog.dbNoneDetected: No database detected on this instance.
